title: Kitchen reconciliation
intro: Compare theoretical kitchen usage (from sales and recipes) with physical counts by location and business date. Draft, verify, and lock reconciliations for inventory accuracy.

sections.title: Reconciliation tab
sections.intro: Generate a reconciliation grid from POS sales and recipe depletion, then enter or import actual counts.
steps: Open Inventory and the Kitchen reconciliation tab.
Select inventory location and business date.
Click Generate to build theoretical usage lines.
Enter actual quantities in the grid or import a CSV.
Save draft, review variances, then Verify (manager PIN when required).
sections.caption: Kitchen reconciliation toolbar, grid, and variance panel.

fields.name: Location
fields.effect: Kitchen or prep store whose stock is being reconciled.

fields.name: Business date
fields.effect: Trading day the theoretical usage and counts apply to.

fields.name: Generate
fields.effect: Creates or refreshes reconciliation lines from sales and recipes.

fields.name: Actual quantity
fields.effect: Physical count entered per item; drives variance vs. theoretical.

fields.name: Verify
fields.effect: Locks the reconciliation after manager approval; prevents casual edits.

sections.title: Manual count entry
sections.intro: Inline grid editing and CSV import share the same line structure.
steps: Click a cell in the Actual column to type a count.
Use Save draft to persist without verifying.
Open CSV import to bulk-load counts from a spreadsheet template.
Review the variance panel for outliers before verifying.
sections.caption: Reconciliation grid with actual quantity editing.

fields.name: Item
fields.effect: Inventory item on the reconciliation line.

fields.name: Theoretical
fields.effect: System-calculated usage from recipes and sales.

fields.name: Actual
fields.effect: Counted on-hand or usage quantity you enter.

fields.name: Variance
fields.effect: Difference between actual and theoretical; highlights shrink or data issues.

fields.name: Notes
fields.effect: Optional explanation stored on the line for audit.
